svg.title: Czechia study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Mikulov; 2: Znojmo; 3: Velké Pavlovice; 4: Slovácko near Uherské Hradiště; 5: Mělník; 6: Litoměřice; 7: Prague; 8: Ostrava; 9: Brno; 10: Pizen; 11: Pardubice; 12: Jihlava

g.title: 4 · Slovácko near Uherské Hradiště: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
